summary.purpose: Internal Go HTTP service that owns authoritative product prices and stock reservations for the CommerceLens platform.
summary.stack: Go 1.23, net/http, PostgreSQL via pgx/v5, Docker multi-stage build
flow: Receive reservation request with orderId and items
Validate JSON body size, unknown fields, and item constraints
Lock product rows with FOR UPDATE and serialize order with advisory lock
Read authoritative prices from inventory_products and decrement available stock
Store reservation and return priced items with subtotal and reserved status
Restore stock to inventory_products and mark reservation released
unknowns: Upstream caller identity (checkout service) is mentioned but not formally documented as a dependency in supplied pages
Database schema details, runtime flows, configuration, and test coverage are referenced but absent from supplied pages
